title: Evidence Results
description: Recorded measurements submitted to `evidence_contract.py evaluate`. Per-variation verdicts are NEVER supplied by the caller; they are derived by the evaluator from these recorded metrics, the contract's tolerances, uncertainty requirements, and decision rules. Any structural violation fails closed as Not Auditable.

contract_id.description: Must match the contract being evaluated.

dimensions.description: Exactly one value per declared allowed-variation dimension. Unknown dimensions or undeclared values fail closed.

metrics.description: Metric name -> recorded measurement. Names must match the contract's metrics.

value.description: The computed metric value per the contract's metric definition (a non-negative discrepancy for accuracy-type metrics).

uncertainty.description: One standard error on `value`, combining the mandatory uncertainty sources.

uncertainty_sources.description: Sources actually included in `uncertainty`. Must cover the contract's mandatory sources or the variation is Indeterminate.

evidence_missing.description: True when evidence for this variation is missing. Consequence is governed by the contract's missing_evidence_policy.on_missing.

identity.description: Explicit identity of the classical baseline actually used (method + implementation).

evidence.description: Each entry must be a repo-relative artifact path that exists, or a citation prefixed 'doi:', 'arXiv:', or 'citation:'. Unverifiable entries fail closed.

matched_inputs.description: True only if the baseline consumed the same instances/inputs as the quantum side.

honored.description: A claim of honoring is accepted only when the baseline block above verifies (identity, evidence, matched inputs); otherwise treated as unhonored.
